CHKDSK.COM.note: Reporting and /F repair of an injected three-cluster orphan chain are asserted, including exact recovered payloads, preservation of a referenced file, and a clean post-repair scan

COUNTRY.SYS.note: Country loading and code-page interaction are asserted

FDISK.EXE.note: Primary, extended, and logical creation, requested-size bounds, containment, CHS/LBA consistency, EBR signature, unused-entry state, and errorlevel behavior are asserted

KEYB.COM.note: Multiple layouts, code pages, IDs, and a focused translated key are asserted

LABEL.COM.note: Read, interactive set/delete, raw persistence, 11-character truncation, and invalid-character rejection with prior-label preservation are asserted

NLSFUNC.EXE.note: Default and explicit COUNTRY.SYS forms, unknown-switch and excess-operand rejection, resident duplicate handling, and code-page interaction are asserted

REPLACE.EXE.note: All six documented modes and interactive confirmation are asserted; /A conflicts, every duplicate switch, an unknown switch, excess filespecs, and their source-defined errorlevels are covered

RESTORE.COM.note: All eight switches, positive and negative filtering, one-file and recursive media sets, interactive confirmation, directory reconstruction, existing-target handling, and binary-exact recovery are asserted; repeated valueless switches are proven idempotent, while unknown, excess-operand, invalid-date/time, and same-drive forms require exact diagnostics and nonzero errorlevels

SELECT.COM.note: BIOS-keyboard stub behavior and transition to SELECT.EXE are asserted

SORT.EXE.note: Ascending ordering is asserted on the deployed floppy under DOS as well as through host execution; reverse and column-key sorting are asserted; /+n accepts both source-defined range endpoints 1 and 65535, rejects adjacent values, and an unknown switch returns errorlevel 1

SUBST.EXE.note: Subdirectory and root mapping, listing, exact I/O, pass-through, and removal are asserted; duplicate, missing, conflicting, unknown, excess, nonexistent-path, and inactive-delete forms require exact diagnostics and errorlevel 1 without disturbing the live mapping
